verdict.rationale: Isaac is installed and run by the user via pip packages, on workstations, Jetson devices, or the user's own data center with headless operation. That implies data stays wherever the user deploys it, but this control is inferred from self-hosting rather than documented as a residency feature. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region-selection documentation, coverage of any NVIDIA-hosted or cloud components and where their data lives, independent corroboration.
